pre_run_expectations: Changing consequence eligibility may alter selected candidate purposes when local gain conflicts with another subject's channels.
Self-interest-first can preserve all channels in some finite contexts; this must be reported.
Others-first qualification can fail under inaccurate forecasts or simultaneous responses; this must be reported.
An empty admissible set is not a successful action and cannot be recorded as a safe solution.
No finite fixture proves or disproves a universal eventual-closure or unique-path claim.
only_policy_difference: whether any named subject's forecast channel closure can disqualify a candidate purpose before selection
